g1.necessity: Prevent incomplete design requirements from being silently marked done when tasks are cancelled or evidence is missing.

g2.authority_owner: Existing TaskStore/Goal lifecycle remains the authority; requirement scope gate checks verified requirement coverage before completion.
g2.non_duplication: Reuses existing Goal/TaskStore evidence, task states and completion flow; does not create a second Goal store or bypass the original complete gate.

model_evidence: Unit tests cover missing requirements, cancelled required tasks, evidence verification and complete coverage.
Original full R9 exit 0 on 21-file predecessor commit 162488350; successor must rerun all gates.
g3.recovery_or_reason: If coverage evidence is missing, block completion and restore required task/test evidence; never auto-cancel a required item to close the Goal.

g4.rollback: Revert the PR through protected GitHub; original Goal evidence and task records remain intact.
verification: Run exact requirement coverage unit tests and A.5 exact-path coverage.
Independent Reviewer PASS P0/P1=0 on successor, original full R9 exit 0, remote PR CI required checks.

g1.necessity: Avoid full-suite reruns during every local development iteration while preserving complete final verification.

g2.authority_owner: Existing r9_commit.sh and ci_gate.sh retain full-R9 commit and release authority; incremental selection is advisory/locally gated and not a push or merge credential.
g2.non_duplication: No second full-test or release authority; --dev requires explicit Host grant and cannot be used on protected paths or main.

model_evidence: Negative tests prove default full R9 remains intact and --dev fails closed without Host activation.
Incremental selection tests exercise unknown impact, protected paths, environment sanitization and receipt validity.
g3.recovery_or_reason: Unknown impact, unsafe path or missing Host grant blocks --dev; fall back to the unchanged original complete R9 for final acceptance.

g4.rollback: Revert feature changes; standard r9_commit.sh full R9 remains the only normal commit path.
verification: Ruff, Pyright, focused incremental/commit tests, full original R9 on successor.
Remote CI and protected merge checks must pass before deployment.

g1.necessity: A local incremental commit must not be authorized by model-generated JSON, environment flags or a reusable software token.

g2.authority_owner: Separate OS Host UID462, root-owned approval and configuration, dedicated Ed25519 key and one-time grant ledger; Owner must approve installation and activation separately.
g2.non_duplication: Separate from premerge, reviewer, Oracle and release signing; authority only permits a scoped local development commit, never git_push/main/CI/release/deployment.

model_evidence: Negative tests cover absent activation, fake approvals, signature mismatch, expiry, replay, dirty tree, SHA drift and wrong branch.
The Host issuer is not installed or activated; test fixtures cannot substitute for OS-level end-to-end proof.
g3.recovery_or_reason: Missing/invalid Host state rejects the dev commit; Owner can revoke activation while retaining append-only issuance and consumption audit records.

g4.rollback: Do not install or activate Host authority in this PR; future Host rollback requires Owner-approved revocation without deleting keys or audit ledger.
verification: Dedicated issuer negative unit tests, independent reviewer, original full R9 and remote CI.
Real Host install/activation/E2E requires separate Owner approval and cannot be claimed by this PR.
